name: Esconet Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2012, Esconet Technologies Ltd is a system integrator in the IT infrastructure, cloud computing, managed services and data security sectors[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ETL is an ISO 9001, ISO 27001, ISO 20000-1, and ISO 14001 certified IT hardware and IT infrastructure company. It is a managed services and Integrator Cloud Service provider, and a manufacturer of Supercomputers.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -0.73%
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.3.60 Cr.
